description: Does a restructure of an API's documentation change what a coding agent builds from it? Claude Code on Sonnet implements six shipping functions in a small shop's Python backend against Tern, an invented carrier, with Tern's docs as shipped, as restructured, or absent. The variants differ only in the docs bundle.

variants.description: Claude Code on Sonnet with Tern's docs as shipped: one quickstart on /v2 that states the units, a reference, a changelog that retires /v1
Claude Code on Sonnet with Tern's docs restructured: a quickstart per language, the Python one still on /v1 in kilograms, the units only in the reference, no changelog
Claude Code on Sonnet with no docs: the docs site answers 404 to every page

surface.description: Tern's documentation site, served at localhost:8080: the quickstart, reference and changelog an agent builds the shop's shipping code from

acceptance.description: the task's hidden tests pass against Tern's sandbox: the right price, every shipment, one booking per order, the right status

current-endpoint.description: the change calls no retired /v1/ endpoint (it still answers, so a run that uses it can pass)

docs-fetched.description: the agent opened the docs site with WebFetch

docs-curled.description: the agent opened the docs site from the shell
